summary: A module is a standalone script Ansible runs locally or remotely that takes arguments and returns JSON on stdout. Local modules can be in any language; this guide covers Python and adding the module where Ansible can find it.
questions: What exactly is an Ansible module?
How does a module return results to Ansible?
Can I write my own module if nothing existing fits?

answer_card.title: What a module is
answer_card.answer_md: A module is a reusable standalone script Ansible runs locally or remotely to perform tasks (e.g. change a DB password, launch a cloud instance). It accepts arguments and returns info by printing **JSON to stdout**. You can write your own in any language for local use; add it to a directory Ansible searches.
